result.title: Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps
result.summary: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 Gumbel Straight Flow，利用预训练自回归语言模型的噪声-数据耦合构造直线流路径，并用流映射半群目标把 AR 教师蒸馏为少步生成模型，在语言生成基准上超过现有少步基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本领域的少步流蒸馏，但其「噪声到表示的非交叉直线路径」与教师引导速度场可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态生成与并行/少步更新、以及轨迹监督的贡献分配提供可核查线索。
